specimenMappings.decision: Native depiction is evidence; source properties do not become runtime node selectors or an invented public state prop.

decisions: Marker maps all three actual wrappers. Native 8px spacing, 16px icon and 14/20px muted text remain semantic roles; native separator lines become flexible pseudo-elements and the border variant adds a logical bottom boundary after 8px separation. The guide shows inline notes, labeled separators and bordered rows; variant alone does not add ARIA separator/status or control semantics. MarkerIcon is actually aria-hidden, so essential meaning stays in text. A caller may explicitly choose role=status for changing work feedback or render a native action. The native guide says asChild, while the pinned selected BaseUI wrapper exposes render; the contract follows the actual render API and retains the guide as source evidence. Optional shimmer is an external caller style utility, not an invented Marker prop or required animation.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
